description: This file defines the ApiService class, which provides a wrapper around Angular's HttpClient for making HTTP requests to backend APIs. It includes methods for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests, and dynamically determines the base URL at runtime. The class handles errors through a dedicated handle method.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Service providing HTTP methods for interacting with backend API endpoints with error handling and configurable base URL.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified API path with optional headers.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the specified API path with request body and optional headers.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request to the specified API path with request body and optional headers.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified API path with optional headers.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles HTTP errors by logging and re-throwing them.
